title: Real education, data visualisation and finance test candidates
scope: Manual test catalogue; 10 education documents and 1 transport document, including 2 data visualisation courses and 2 finance learning resources
limitations: No correction runs or participant evaluations performed.
Simulation findings are candidate issues, not measured human usability outcomes.
Publisher URLs can change; verify SHA-256 before reusing page annotations.
Third-party originals and generated previews remain Git-ignored local files; no redistribution licence is inferred.

documents.reader_task: Identify curves f, g, i and h; estimate when each reaches 10 degrees C.
documents.reference_answer: Approximately f: 5 h; g: 10 h; i: 24 h; h: not within the plotted interval. Allow 1 h for reading.
documents.colour_risk: Small green/yellow curve labels and traces lose hue separation in the protanopia preview.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep all four curves, labels, axes, A/B/D points and reference-line coordinates consistent.
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.reader_task: Match Paleocene and Lower Cretaceous regions in the Atlantic map to their legend swatches.
documents.reference_answer: The two geological categories must remain distinct and mapped to their original regions; use the source legend as reference.
documents.colour_risk: Several brown, green, pink and orange geological classes converge in the protanopia preview.
documents.preservation_requirement: Treat the main map, age legend and Azores inset consistently; retain boundaries and labels.
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.publisher: Tanguy Jean, Lycee Valentine Labbe, classe preparatoire TB
documents.reader_task: Compare mitosis and meiosis; follow chromosome origins through crossing-over and into gametes in the summary diagram.
documents.reference_answer: The distinction between original and exchanged chromosome segments must agree with the source diagrams and allele labels.
documents.colour_risk: Red/green process headings converge; very small blue/orange chromosome segments require zoom. Existing text and line-weight cues can already suffice.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep allele labels, segment order, arrow connections, drawings and nearby biological images intact.
documents.test_role: mixed teaching diagram with existing redundant cues
documents.source_title: Aspects genetiques et chromosomiques de la reproduction
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.reader_task: Decide whether maps A and B show different data, identify the alternative scale in C and explain the deliberate breakpoint in D.
documents.reference_answer: The maps show the same data; C is the lesson comparison scale; D emphasises 27.8 degrees C.
documents.colour_risk: Rainbow bands become less distinct, while differing scale designs are themselves the teaching material.
documents.preservation_requirement: Retain the deliberate A-D scale comparison and threshold emphasis; use a separate explanation or needs_review rather than homogenising palettes.
documents.source_title: Exploring Color Maps - Visualizing the Ozone Hole
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.publisher: College Jean Jaures, Poissy, Academie de Versailles
documents.reader_task: Use the photographed pH wheel and numerical meter; classify the shown meter reading as acidic, neutral or basic.
documents.reference_answer: The digital meter reading is below pH 7, so the sample is acidic; retain the displayed digits.
documents.colour_risk: Adjacent hues on a photographed measurement reference become harder to distinguish.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep the physical pH-wheel and instrument photographs unchanged; offer textual support separately or mark needs_review.
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.publisher: Ministere de l Education nationale et de la Jeunesse, Eduscol
documents.reader_task: Read the BBT transition interval and named colours, and locate an alternative to matching pH-paper colours.
documents.reference_answer: The table gives 6.0-7.6 with yellow and blue named in text; the pH-meter section supplies a numerical measurement alternative.

documents.reader_task: Trace RER A and RER D from Chatelet-Les Halles to Gare de Lyon using letter badges without switching at crossings.
documents.reference_answer: Both labelled routes connect these stations in the source map; preserve their separate identities and connections.
documents.colour_risk: Dense thin route lines and intersections lose hue separation in the protanopia preview; line badges provide redundant identifiers.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep station names, interchange topology and official route identities. The map is marked 01.2026 and is a test snapshot.
documents.test_role: everyday navigation with standardised route identities
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.reader_task: Use the Product Type legend to identify the points below -$500 profit and the category of the highest-profit point.
documents.reference_answer: Tea has the cluster below -$500; Coffee has the highest-profit point in this screenshot.
documents.colour_risk: Small overlapping green and orange category marks converge in the protanopia preview.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep the four product categories, point positions and legend consistent. Page 58 shapes encode Market, not Product Type; page 30 is an intentional heatmap-versus-position comparison.

documents.audience: Data visualisation students learning quantitative scales
documents.reader_task: Locate the 1:1 reference on the heatmap legend and distinguish visible cells encoded on opposite sides of that reference.
documents.reference_answer: The printed legend has a 1:1 ratio reference, with green and red on opposite sides. Preserve its two directions and fold-change labels; it is not labelled as a signed scale with a zero midpoint.
documents.colour_risk: Opposing red and green heatmap hues become similar. The diverging ratio scale must retain its 1:1 reference and both directions.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep visible cell positions, row and column order, dendrogram, labels, scale endpoints and 1:1 ratio reference consistent. Do not invent negative values or a zero midpoint. The source figure is clipped at the bottom: do not reconstruct hidden rows. Review deliberate palette demonstrations separately.
documents.test_role: learner chart reading: diverging heatmap with a 1:1 ratio reference
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed
documents.source_notes: pypdf reports recoverable cross-reference warnings; selected pages render successfully. The source PDF has not been repaired or rewritten.

documents.audience: Finance students learning portfolio risk and return
documents.reader_task: Follow the four correlation-labelled curves and identify which offers the lowest standard deviation near 10% expected return.
documents.reference_answer: The rho = -1 case reaches the lowest risk near that expected return in the supplied diagram.
documents.colour_risk: Thin green and orange curves become similarly yellow in the protanopia preview; existing labels and dash patterns remain useful.
documents.preservation_requirement: Preserve correlation labels, dash patterns, endpoints, axes, percentage units and all curve geometry; retain the adjacent explanations.
documents.test_role: finance learning: expected-return and risk curves
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed

documents.audience: Learners reading financial charts and indicator panels
documents.reader_task: Distinguish rising and falling candles, then use the component legend on PDF page 162 to match the three lower indicator lines to their right-edge badges on page 163.
documents.reference_answer: The setup identifies +DI as green, ADX as black and -DI as red. At the right edge of the displayed panel, +DI is highest, ADX is in the middle and -DI is lowest. Candle anatomy can be checked with the labelled numerical examples on page 15.
documents.colour_risk: Red/green candles and indicator lines lose hue separation in the protanopia preview. This book uses different candle palettes in different chapters.
documents.preservation_requirement: Keep open/high/low/close semantics, candle bodies and wicks, time and price axes, indicator names and displayed values intact. Any remapping must agree with the page-specific component legend and surrounding colour words. PDF page 163 is printed page 162.
documents.test_role: finance learning: candle direction and indicator identity
documents.inspection_status: primary original and protanopia preview visually reviewed
